BUSINESS_RULE: Age must be >= 18 for biologic eligibility
Map ICD-10 to therapy area: M05-M06=Rheumatology, L40=Dermatology, K50-K51=GI, C83-C91=HemOnc, G43=Migraine

TRANSFORMATION: CASE WHEN PLAN_TYPE_CD IN ('HMO','PPO','POS') THEN 'Commercial' WHEN PLAN_TYPE_CD='MCR' THEN 'Medicare' WHEN PLAN_TYPE_CD='MCD' THEN 'Medicaid' ELSE 'Other' END

BUSINESS_RULE: Group NDC to brand-level using GPI hierarchy
Map AHFS to MOA category per medical affairs classification
First 4 digits of GPI determine therapy area assignment
Map NDC to brand-level DRUG_ID via product hierarchy
Exclude future dates and dates > 2 years old
Must be between 1 and 365; flag anomalies > 90 for review
IF same patient has Rx for different drug in same therapy area within 60 days prior THEN prior drug = switch_from
Infer from diagnosis codes on claims around switch date: adverse event codes=AE, new diagnosis=inadequate response
Map taxonomy code to specialty name per NUCC reference
TRUE if: (publications > 10 in therapy area) OR (clinical trial PI) OR (advisory board member) OR (top 10% prescriber volume)
Map CCN to health system via CMS hospital compare affiliation file

Algorithm: IF (dechallenge positive AND rechallenge positive) THEN 'Definite' ELIF (temporal + known ADR + no alternative) THEN 'Probable' ELIF (temporal + possible alternative) THEN 'Possible' ELSE 'Unlikely'
Determined by: 1st biologic in therapy area = L1. Switch to new MOA = next line. Same MOA different drug = same line lateral switch.
Use CORTEX.COMPLETE to extract switching criteria from clinical guideline PDFs (ACR, AAD, AGA, NCCN)
